intro: AOBS is an **esports broadcast production company**. We produce live tournaments end to end, and we build the technology we run them on.
story: {{TODO: company story: founding year, origin and milestones}}
mission: Put every tournament on air at a standard its players deserve, and keep it there.
where: Our broadcast record spans events in Pakistan (Pakistan Community Cup), Nepal (MLBB tournament teaser; Battle of Gurkha's) and Bangladesh (DIU Winter Fest at Daffodil International University; Bangla-language sponsor integrations). {{TODO: confirm head office location and regions served}}

different.title: Broadcast first
different.text: Production is the core of the company, not a side service. Observers, replay, graphics and transmission sit in one crew.

different.title: Data-driven graphics
different.text: Our graphics read the game. Live API data fills scorebugs, drafts and stats automatically.

different.title: We build our own tools
different.text: AOBS Cloud, our OBS plugins and Backup Streamer exist because we needed them on real shows.

different.title: Built not to go dark
different.text: Redundancy is part of the design. A backup path runs for the whole broadcast.
